login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Access your accounting files.

login.devHint: AUTH_MODE=dev: the API accepts X-User-Id, X-Tenant-Id and X-Organization-Id headers without a token.
login.invalidTenant: The company file must be a UUID.
login.required: User id and company file are required.
company.manualHint: The company list arrives with the firm portal; enter the company UUID.
locale.label: Language
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Company position for fiscal year {fy}
dashboard.noEntries: No entry recorded from this device yet.
dashboard.emptyBody: Record your first entry or import a trial balance to feed the dashboard.
entries.title: Entries
entries.subtitle: Record, validate and reverse double-entry journal entries.
entries.movementsHint: Debit / credit totals of accounts with movements over the fiscal year (trial balance).
entries.recentHint: Entries created from this device (the API does not list entries yet).
entries.byId: Act on an entry by id
entries.byIdHint: Paste an entry id (UUID) to validate, reverse or discard it.
entries.validateConfirm: Validate this entry? It becomes immutable and receives a journal number.
entries.reverseConfirm: Reverse this entry? An opposite entry will be created and validated.
entries.discardConfirm: Discard this draft? This cannot be undone.
entries.queued: Offline: draft queued, it will be sent when the network is back.
entries.chainHint: Checks integrity and continuous numbering of a journal's validated entries.
entries.form.title: New entry
entries.form.label: Label
entries.form.errorLines: Each line needs an account and either a debit or a credit amount (not both).
entries.form.accountsUnavailable: Chart of accounts unavailable: type the number directly.
balance.title: Trial balance
balance.subtitle: Debit and credit balances by account over fiscal year {fy}.
balance.empty: No account with movements over the period.
statements.title: Financial statements
statements.subtitle: Balance sheet, income statement, cash-flow statement and notes (revised SYSCOHADA).
statements.notPublishableHint: Blocking controls fail: fix them before publishing.
statements.orphansHint: Accounts with movements that no line picks up.
statements.noPrevious: Without a previous fiscal year, the N-1 column and the cash-flow statement are empty.
accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.subtitle: Revised SYSCOHADA chart of the company; leaf accounts receive entries.
accounts.empty: Chart of accounts empty or unavailable.
settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Company, country pack, language and session.
settings.companyHint: Detailed company information arrives with the firm portal.
soon.title: Coming soon
soon.body: The "{module}" module arrives in a later release. Its entries will flow through the ledger, the single source of truth.
pack.notice.vat.title: Pack {pack} awaiting validation
pack.notice.vat.body: This pack's VAT rates are indicative: they have not yet been validated by a chartered accountant of the country. The period position remains available, but no return produced from this pack can be submitted to the tax authority.
pack.notice.vatReturn.title: Unofficial return — pack {pack} awaiting validation
pack.notice.vatReturn.body: This computation uses indicative rates that no chartered accountant of the country has validated. The return cannot be submitted to the tax authority as it stands.
pack.notice.dsf.title: Unofficial filing — pack {pack} awaiting validation
pack.notice.dsf.body: The tax reconciliation and the tax due shown here rest on indicative scales that no chartered accountant of the country has validated. This filing cannot be submitted to the tax authority.
pack.notice.payslip.title: Unofficial payslip — pack {pack} awaiting validation
pack.notice.payslip.body: The contributions, deductions and net pay on this payslip are computed with indicative rates that no chartered accountant of the country has validated. This payslip is not a supporting document for any tax or social security body.
pack.rates.draft: VAT rates from pack {pack}, awaiting validation: indicative values.
common.packNotPublished: Refused: pack {pack} is at status {status}. A chartered accountant of the country must validate its rates and scales, and the pack must reach PUBLISHED, before any legal document can be produced from it.
